name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Rs 6000 per year in 3 instalments
description: Income support for farmer families who own cultivable land with direct bank transfer for farmers

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Low-interest crop loan and credit for farming needs
description: Easy short term credit for farmers to buy seeds fertilizer and farm inputs at low interest

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection for the household
documents: Aadhaar;BPL or ration card;Bank account;Passport photo
description: Free cooking gas connection for women from poor below poverty line households

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
benefit: Monthly pension (central share plus state top-up)
description: Monthly pension for poor senior citizens aged 60 and above living below poverty line

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
benefit: Monthly pension for widows
description: Monthly pension for poor widows between 40 and 79 years of age

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
benefit: Monthly pension for persons with severe disability
documents: Disability certificate (80 percent or more);BPL card;Aadhaar;Bank passbook
description: Monthly pension for poor persons with severe disability aged 18 to 79

name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin
benefit: Financial help to build a pucca house (Rs 1.2 lakh in plains)
documents: Aadhaar;Job card;Bank passbook;Awaas+ or SECC listing proof
description: Housing assistance for rural families who have no house or live in a kutcha house

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year
description: Free hospital treatment insurance for poor and vulnerable families

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana
benefit: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh for senior citizens
description: Free health insurance for every citizen aged 70 years and above

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
benefit: Rs 5000 in instalments for first child (Rs 6000 if second child is a girl)
description: Cash support for pregnant and nursing mothers for nutrition and rest

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High-interest savings account for a girl child
description: Savings scheme for the future education and marriage of a girl child under 10 years

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
benefit: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay card and accident cover
documents: Aadhaar or other ID proof;Passport photo
description: Basic bank account for people who do not have one

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: Rs 2 lakh accident cover for Rs 20 per year
description: Very low cost accident insurance for death or disability

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: Rs 2 lakh life cover for Rs 436 per year
description: Low cost life insurance for family protection

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: Monthly pension of Rs 1000 to 5000 after age 60
description: Pension savings plan for unorganised workers who are not income tax payers

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
benefit: Tuition fee and maintenance allowance
documents: Caste certificate;Income certificate;Admission proof;Previous marksheet;Aadhaar;Bank passbook
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students studying after class 10 whose family income is low

name: NMMSS Merit Scholarship
benefit: Rs 12000 per year for class 9 to 12
description: Scholarship for meritorious school students from poor families to reduce dropouts

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Rs 15000 toolkit grant and loan up to Rs 3 lakh at 5 percent

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Working capital loan starting at Rs 10000

name: MGNREGA
benefit: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment
description: Guaranteed manual work and wages for rural households

name: PM Mudra Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free business loan up to Rs 20 lakh
description: Loans for small shops and micro businesses and self employed people

name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
benefit: Rs 2000 per month to woman head of the family
description: Monthly cash for the woman head of a household in Karnataka

name: Gruha Jyothi (Karnataka)
benefit: Free electricity up to 200 units per month
description: Free household electricity for families in Karnataka
